howto.name: Upload a .pptx file
howto.text: Drop a PowerPoint presentation up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Each slide becomes one PDF page
howto.text: PrivaTools renders fonts, animations (first state), embedded images, and SmartArt diagrams.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: The output preserves slide aspect ratio (16:9 or 4:3 as designed).

faq.a: PDF doesn't support animation. Each slide renders in its initial state. For animation, export to video first.
Speaker notes are not included in the PDF, and there is no option to add them. Export the notes from your presentation software if you need them.
Videos render as a poster frame (the first frame). Use Extract Audio + Video to PDF for video-centric conversion.
